terminals.name: staging-sql-tunnel
terminals.command:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; umask 077; mkdir -p "$HOME/.ssh"; chmod 700 "$HOME/.ssh"; python3 - <<"PY"
import os, pathlib
key=os.environ.get("DRVO_STAGING_SSH_KEY")
host=os.environ.get("DRVO_STAGING_SSH_HOST")
if not key: raise SystemExit("DRVO_STAGING_SSH_KEY is not set")
if not host: raise SystemExit("DRVO_STAGING_SSH_HOST is not set")
p=pathlib.Path.home()/".ssh"/"drvo_agent"
p.write_text(key if key.endswith("\n") else key+"\n")
PY
chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/drvo_agent"; KNOWN_HOSTS="$HOME/.ssh/known_hosts_drvo_staging"; : > "$KNOWN_HOSTS"; chmod 600 "$KNOWN_HOSTS"; exec ssh -N -L 127.0.0.1:14330:127.0.0.1:1433 -i "$HOME/.ssh/drvo_agent" "drvo-tunnel@${DRVO_STAGING_SSH_HOST}" -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS"'
